title: SanitizedContext
description: The only shape of page-derived context allowed to cross the network boundary from the extension to the server. Phase 5: a contract-shape proof, not real sanitized content — real content and real sanitization guarantees arrive in Phase 7.

version.description: Schema version. Bump on any breaking change to this contract.

page_url_hash.description: A hash of the page URL, never the raw URL — avoids leaking navigation history verbatim even in this stub phase.

elements.description: Non-sensitive, structural UI elements only. No raw screenshots, no raw DOM text beyond short accessible labels.
